summary: Home Office drive to stop small boats crossing Channel is handing more power to people smugglers, report finds The UK’s policy to stop asylum seekers from crossing the Channel in small boats has led to an increase in violence, deaths and smuggler control, but has not deterred arrivals, according to a report by human rights organisations.
